quotes.text: We were about to follow this advice, when another man, more rash than his comrades, said, 'I'm not afraid of caymans,' and spurred his horse into the stream.
With a dull, heavy splash an occasional cayman plunged in from the bank.
quotes.reference: 1912, Arthur Conan Doyle, The Lost World […], London; New York, N.Y.: Hodder and Stoughton, →OCLC:

quotes.text: Surely, when this animal comes, it is to eat us. Thus, we have to sing this hoa. This is how I learned this hoa for caymans. One sings this so he won't be eaten by the caymans.
quotes.reference: 1996, Dale Alan Olsen, editor, Music of the Warao of Venezuela: Song People of the Rain Forest, page 326:

quotes.text: Laguna Tortuguero has some 2,000 caimanes (caymans), a type of alligator indigenous to Central and S America.
